LESSON: MY PURPOSE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation Talents and Abilities
Topic 1.1: My Purpose

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: My Purpose
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how I use my talents and abilities’. How do you use your God-given talents and abilities?

2. explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities
